name: morning-triage
description: The scheduled triage digest: collect what accumulated across your inbox, channels and background runs, filter it through your own rules, propose what to do, and deliver one ranked digest through the notification gate.

window_hours.help: How far back to look when no digest has completed yet. Once one has, the window is 'since the last successful digest' and this is ignored — so a missed morning is caught up rather than skipped.

max_proposals.help: Ceiling on proposals in one digest. Eight is the hard maximum; a lower number is a way of asking for only the most important few.

metadata.why_cheap: Two background-tier calls at most, and often zero: a quiet window short-circuits before the first one, and a window your own filter rules empty never reaches the second. Neither call is a stage — there is no session, no toolset and no retry loop.

steering_examples.description: Only surface review requests from GitHub, and skip dependabot entirely.
Cap this one at three proposals — just the things that actually need me.

example_outputs: one ranked digest: what your machine did, what needs you, and what your rules filtered out
metadata.when_not_to_use: it proposes and delivers — it executes nothing, so it is not how you get your inbox cleared
